name: mosaic-compile
description:
Compile a .mosaic component file to a target output format.

Reads the unified .mosaic file format (interface + layout + style in one file)
and emits to the specified backend.

flags.description: Output backend: 'webcomponent' (Custom Element JS) or 'html' (static HTML file)
Path to a JSON fixture file providing slot values (for --backend html)
Path to a CSS file to inline in the HTML output (for --backend html)

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Path to the .mosaic source file to compile
